## Cohort 03 is frozen: P07

**P07 is satisfactory in the exercised T2 conversation scope.** No material blocker was observed. The review is frozen at **2026-11-01 11:51:04 UTC**, with the compact-input and attachment-disclosure tradeoffs retained explicitly.

Cohorts 01 and 02 remain unchanged. Both prior cohorts’ immutable hashes were verified, and all **thirteen earlier product rows** were preserved when P07 was appended. The cumulative record now contains **14 products**. No condition mapping was received, no comparator was repaired, and all preview processes I started have stopped.

### Findings supporting the judgment

The original desktop, compact and narrow captures retain a coherent mature workspace: a centered reading column, clear paragraph hierarchy, restrained message actions and an anchored composer. Light and dark bilingual content remained readable. The fresh narrow filename dialog displayed the complete filename and the filename-only explanation within the viewport.

The exercised workflow supported the key continuity requirements:

- **Manual reading position:** scrollTop stayed at **91 px** while response height grew from **1,391 to 1,727 px**.
- **Return to latest:** the bottom gap was **0** at every sample across approximately **1.5 seconds** of continued streaming.
- **Keyboard Stop:** the runtime stopped and focus returned to the composer by the first **100 ms** observation. Recorded text length remained unchanged in subsequent samples.
- **Attachment recovery:** Escape returned focus to the filename trigger, and removing a file returned focus to the composer. The last attachment in the narrow horizontal strip remained reachable.
- **Failure and retry:** the partial synthetic failure was clearly visible; keyboard retry completed the full fixed response through **Observation theme 7**.
- **Return/reload:** a follow-up question could be sent and stopped, and reload returned to the seeded conversation as required by the in-memory contract.

The [core behavior record](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/e1cfe6e447ee/ui-study/independent-review-recovery/evidence/behavior-conversations-cohort03-P07-001/P07.json) retains the actual state observations, checks, screenshots and server lifecycle.

### Remaining tradeoffs and limits

At compact height, the input is capped at **6rem**. The fresh screenshot showed the last four lines of the six-line question; earlier lines were above the input’s current visible portion. The full question remained present and was sent. This preserves more reading space while requiring internal input scrolling.

The attachment strip also requires horizontal browsing when several long filenames are present. Full-name disclosure uses a modal that temporarily blurs the conversation, and Return to latest remains an icon with a localized tooltip/accessibility name.

The review did not establish a complete assistive-technology path, physical-touch behavior, arbitrary attachment counts, extreme filename or draft lengths, every message-edit/branch action, reduced-motion playback or a browser matrix. Original captures and fresh captures differed in persistent scrollbar appearance; the report preserves that observation without attributing it to an unverified product change.

Source inspection confirmed that the File and Button components, synthetic adapter, dependency lock and product license matched the foundation. The Dialog change localizes its close text, and the font CSS had no line differences. These are delivered-source findings, with no external provenance authentication implied.
